info.description: Filterable grid of images and videos. A tile opens a lightbox with previous and next controls.

maxColumns.description: Maximum columns on a wide screen. Narrower screens use fewer columns, and never more than this number.

showItemTitles.description: Show each item title under its tile. A title or caption still appears along the bottom of the lightbox when you enter one.

categories.description: Filter pills, in the order they should appear. Tag each media item with the same label. Matching ignores capitalization and extra spaces.
